title: IKOB Aporometrica: data of the Utrecht paper runs (inputs, skims, runs and tables)
description: The inputs, travel-time skims, model runs and paper tables behind the paper "Either you can reach it or you cannot" (threshold-gate accessibility, Utrecht shared bicycles), computed with IKOB Aporometrica (https://github.com/Marrekoo/IKOB_Aporometrica). The archives unpack into a data folder of the software: the GTFS NL feed and OpenStreetMap extracts used for the skims, the CBS neighbourhood GeoPackage and the LISA municipal job table; the skim stores of the study area and the imputed jobs per buurt and sector; the run folders of the run plans paper/runs.toml and paper/perturbation.toml and the paper tables. MANIFEST.sha256 lists the SHA-256 of every file, the same hashes each run records in its run.json. README.md gives the steps.
notes: OpenStreetMap data and the skims derived from them: ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors. GTFS NL: OVapi. CBS Kerncijfers wijken en buurten: CC BY 4.0. LISA municipal data: LISA (https://www.lisa.nl/gratis-data/). Model outputs: CC BY 4.0. ODiN microdata are not included (DANS).
